notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run. No deviation from the card: the family-config decision and the MujocoDriver helper express the model files. The card lists no entry_symbols, so there was no Python symbol to verify; the two card models exist in the clone, and the package serves models[0] xml/scene.xml, whose include loads models[1] xml/jvrc1.xml. The loaded model has a free root joint plus 44 hinge joints (51 qpos, 50 qvel) and 34 motor actuators. MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs (no network, no pip), so the fake backend is fake.py, a stand-in mujoco module: it parses the MJCF for the joint dimensions and the actuator list, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion and resolves no mesh, contact, equality, tendon or sensor; it was never compared with the real engine. The sim path (a backend that backends does not name, which imports the real mujoco) was not run. No control limit is declared: the jvrc1 motor class sets ctrllimited=false and forcelimited=false (xml/jvrc1.xml:11-13) and the 34 motors declare no ctrlrange, so the bridge derives no actuator_ctrlrange and the step action accepts any value; no bound was invented or copied from a catalogue default. The derived action.ctrl length 34 is the model's actuator count, not a safety bound. Expected warnings, all explained: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the fake is a stand-in library object, not the upstream simulator, so native calls are not recorded and G7 has no fake surface); G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE (no limit on any actuating capability, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe); G8.NO_UNIT x3 (the bridge-derived inputs ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed). There are no operator-required limits, so no site-limits.example.json is needed. No catalogue requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package. The upstream clone was not modified.
